answer.reason: Achbor is named in 2KI 22:12-14 as one sent by King Josiah to enquire of the LORD through Huldah the prophetess, which is a deed beyond the summary; the JER verses concern his son Elnathan and 2CH 34:20 names Abdon, a different name.

clauses.english: was sent by the king to enquire of the LORD about the book of the law, and went to Huldah the prophetess
clauses.quote: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people

doubts: 2CH 34:20 names Abdon the son of Micah in the parallel account, which may be the same man but is a different name, so it was left out.
JER 26:22 and JER 36:12 concern his son Elnathan, not Achbor himself, so they were left out.
